name: Life Simulation Plugin (AI-Driven)
name_zh-CN: 事件及人体模拟插件（AI驱动）
description: AI-driven life simulation: schedule, events, habits, holidays, and emotion judgment for human-like behavior
description_zh-CN: AI驱动的生活模拟：日程、事件、习惯、节日和情绪判断，实现拟人化行为

components.name: life_simulation_social_network
components.description: Process social network interactions and update intimacy

components.name: life_simulation_sleep
components.description: Handle sleep state and block messages during sleep

components.name: get_life_simulation_habits
components.description: Get personal habits information (speaking, behavior, interests, preferences)

components.name: get_social_network_info
components.description: Get social network information, including user relationships and intimacy

components.name: set_user_relationship
components.description: Set user relationship type (stranger, acquaintance, friend, close_friend, best_friend, family, partner, enemy, blocked)

components.name: get_life_simulation_schedule
components.description: Get schedule information, including current activity and all scheduled activities

components.name: get_life_simulation_status
components.description: Get current status including physiological states, current activity, and holiday information

features: AI-driven schedule generation (work, leisure, meals, daily routine)
AI-driven random event generation
Health status determined by random events and schedule
Habits from config or AI-generated based on personality
Holiday API integration for dynamic holiday detection
AI-driven emotion judgment based on multiple factors
Illness system: AI judges illness based on multiple factors
Auto-regenerate schedule based on health status
All prompts in config file (fully customizable)
AI-generated dialogue (no fixed messages)
Read-only physiological state data (cannot be modified by commands)
Configurable AI models (tool_use, planner, replyer, utils, vlm, voice, embedding, lpmm_entity_extract, lpmm_rdf_build)
Customizable time/date API
Prompts loaded from config file (not hardcoded)
User-friendly configuration file
Tool component for LLM to access habits information
Social network system for managing user relationships
Intimacy system with growth and decay mechanisms
AI-driven intimacy judgment based on interaction content
Tool component for LLM to set user relationship type (including enemy and blocked)
Tool component for LLM to get schedule information and current activity
Tool component for LLM to get current status information (fatigue, hunger, health, emotion, sleep state etc.)
Complete sleep system with 6 sleep states and automatic transitions
Sleep-schedule integration: automatically enters/wakes up based on schedule activities
AI-driven auto-reply during sleep: intelligently judges whether to reply
Disturbance wake-up: can be woken by frequent messages, important senders, or urgent keywords

1.7.0: Removed AI-driven auto-reply during sleep system
Removed sleep_reply_judgment AI prompt
Simplified sleep reply to use fixed message from config file
Removed ai_reply_enabled, ai_model, and ai_reply_probability configuration options
Sleep system now uses configured sleep_reply message directly
Disturbance wake-up mechanism remains functional
Fixed sleep state logic: awake and sleepy states allow normal processing, other sleep states (falling_asleep, light_sleep, deep_sleep, waking_up) block messages without reply
Removed duplicate disturbance wake-up check code
Fixed missing prompts in default config: added social_network_analysis and intimacy_judgment prompts to _get_default_config_content method
Fixed config file generation check: updated _ensure_config_with_prompts and _write_default_config_with_prompts to check all 6 prompts including social_network_analysis and intimacy_judgment
Added fallback mechanism in _get_prompt: if prompt not found in config file, automatically load from default config to prevent 'empty prompt' errors
Fixed TOML parsing issue in plugin_base.py: updated to use tomllib (Python 3.11+ builtin) instead of toml library to fix multi-line string parsing bug that caused only 3 prompts to be loaded
Enhanced habit_generation prompt: added explicit rules and examples to prevent LLM from using quotes inside JSON strings, which caused JSON parsing failures
Optimized intimacy judgment: added ai_judgment_probability configuration to control how often AI is called for intimacy increase (default: 30%)
Added logging configuration: logging.level and logging.verbose settings to control debug log output
Production version does not include debug commands (only in debug version)

Fixed social network interaction during sleep: added sleep state check in SocialNetworkEventHandler to skip interaction recording during sleep states (falling_asleep, light_sleep, deep_sleep, waking_up), preventing inappropriate intimacy increases while sleeping
Added notice message filtering: SocialNetworkEventHandler now skips notice messages (e.g., group_recall) to prevent inappropriate interaction recording for system notifications
Fixed waking_up state transition: added handling for WAKING_UP state in schedule change logic to properly transition to AWAKE state, preventing WAKING_UP state from getting stuck

Fixed random event generation in debug command: added check_probability parameter to _generate_random_event method, allowing debug commands to force trigger events without probability checks, preventing false 'event generation failed' messages when events are generated but fail probability check
Fixed intimacy judgment prompt formatting: escaped curly braces in JSON examples (changed {} to {{}}) to prevent KeyError during prompt.format() when formatting prompts with JSON format examples

Added recent event tracking: added recent_event and recent_event_time fields to state to track recently handled random events, allowing GetScheduleTool to display recent events (within last 5 minutes) when user asks 'what are you doing', providing more natural and contextual responses about recent activities

Fixed event-schedule conflict: when a random event occurs, current activity is temporarily changed to 'handling_event' during event processing, then restored to the previous schedule activity after event is handled, preventing logical conflicts between scheduled activities and random events

Fixed event persistence: added state save after handling random events in _handle_event method, ensuring recent_event information is persisted to file and can be retrieved by GetScheduleTool, preventing 'no recent event found' issue when user asks 'what are you doing'

Enhanced schedule description: updated schedule_generation prompt to require detailed activity descriptions (e.g., '在图书馆写论文' instead of just '写论文'), helping AI better understand what the robot is doing

Added time information to GetScheduleTool: now returns current activity time and current time (HH:MM and date) in the response, allowing the main reply system to know the current time and provide more contextual responses

Enhanced get_life_simulation_status tool: now retrieves detailed activity description from schedule array instead of using brief current_activity_description field, and adds current activity time and current time (HH:MM and date) to status output, providing more comprehensive and detailed status information for AI to understand current context

Fixed social network interaction recording: SocialNetworkEventHandler now only records interactions and judges intimacy when the message is directed to bot (private messages, or group messages where bot is mentioned or @ed), preventing inappropriate intimacy increases for messages not directed to bot
